safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated contains no penicillin allergy information (allergies section empty).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting a penicillin allergy can lead to inadvertent prescribing/administration of beta-lactam antibiotics, which could provoke an allergic reaction including anaphylaxis. In an acute-care setting where medications may be given rapidly, lack of this allergy documentation meaningfully increases patient safety risk.
